newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian base metals steady in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian base metals steady in sluggish trade.

text.p: Indian base metals prices were little changed in sluggish trade on Friday, traders said.
They said attendance was poor and supply of imported metals from the Bombay port was limited because of the Moslem festival of Eid al-Adha.
Copper was steady at 13,450 rupees per quintal while nickel was unchanged at 35,800 rupees after losing 200 rupees on Thursday. Aluminium stayed at 7,450 rupees, zinc at 7,850 and lead at 4,550.
